notes.title: Find other players and watch our development
notes.content:
Happy New Year everyone!  

For anyone who's downloaded the game and finding it frustrating to find someone online at the same time as you, we feel your pain. As we are still early access, our player base is rather small at the moment. We have set up a Big Bang Billiards discord channel where any players and Beta testers can communicate with each other and the developers and arrange for times to play the game. 

Feel free to follow this link to our [url=https://discord.gg/PpzFXU7] DISCORD CHANNEL [/url] here.

And for any folks out there who might be on the fence about downloading our game, we'd like to invite you to check out our developer videos for close-up looks at the many features we've added to the game over the past few months.

Check out our [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCnJ80miDBV1C3Lu9eT4nO9w/playlists] Youtube Channel [/url] here.

And we would love to hear from our players out there. If you experience any bugs or want to request features, please post in our community boards. And if you like the game, please consider writing us a review on Steam or reviewing the game on other sites.

notes.title: Early Access has Launched!
notes.content:
We are extremely excited to get this game in front of players. 

Thanks to our beta testers for helping us refine the game over the past few months.

Recent additions include: 
- Semi-opaque table walls to help guide your shots.
- Options for rotation pivot point: You can rotate around the cue-ball, around your hands, or around the center of the table.
- Updated sounds effects for the fruit and metal ball sets.

Please send us your feedback and bug reports in the Steam discussions pages for the game. Also, let us know if you have any ideas for game modes and other fun stuff. We will do our best to squash bugs quickly.

Enjoy the game! See you on the table!
